slices.name: Email Infrastructure + Send
slices.description: Foundation infrastructure (S3, DNS, SES receipt rules, IAM) plus the complete outbound email path: emailAdmin Lambda send route, DynamoDB email storage, SES sending, frontend compose UI. Enables operators to send an email to a lead from the dashboard.

Extend: add putEmail(), updateLeadEmailMetadata() functions

Extend: add emailAdmin entry point

Extend: add lastEmailAt and unreadEmailCount optional fields to Lead interface

slices.name: Email Thread View
slices.description: Read path for email conversations: emailAdmin Lambda list route, DynamoDB query for emails by lead, frontend thread and bubble components. Enables operators to view the full email conversation for a lead.

Integration test: seed emails in DynamoDB, GET /emails/{leadId}, verify chronological order, pagination, and total count

slices.name: Inbound Email Processing
slices.description: Event-driven inbound pipeline: emailReceive Lambda triggered by S3, MIME parsing with mailparser, lead matching by email address, auto-create lead for unknown senders, attachment extraction to S3. Enables receiving emails and auto-creating leads.

Extend: add IAM role and policies for email receive Lambda (S3 read/write, DynamoDB full access, SES send for forwarding, CloudWatch logs, SQS DLQ)
New file: MIME parsing wrapper using mailparser. Extracts from, to, subject, body, attachments. Sanitizes HTML, normalizes email addresses, truncates bodies
Extend: add findLeadByEmail() function (Scan with email filter, normalized lowercase)
New file: S3 event handler. Reads raw email from S3, parses MIME, finds or creates lead, stores attachments, writes email record, updates lead metadata
Extend: add emailReceive entry point

Integration test: simulate S3 event with raw MIME email, verify email record created in DynamoDB, lead matched, metadata updated
Integration test: simulate inbound from unknown sender, verify new lead created with status NEW and temperature WARM, email record linked

slices.name: Mark Read + Unread Indicators
slices.description: Read state management: emailAdmin Lambda mark-read route, DynamoDB batch update of readAt, lead unreadEmailCount reset. Frontend unread badges on lead cards, lastEmailAt sorting, email preview. Enables operators to see and manage unread status.

Integration test: verify lead record includes unreadEmailCount after inbound email, verify count resets after mark-read

slices.name: Backup Forwarding + Hardening
slices.description: Non-critical enhancements: backup forwarding of inbound emails to personal address, DLQ alarm, comprehensive error handling for edge cases (parse failures, partial data, retry safety). Completes the feature for production readiness.

components.description: Extend: add backup forwarding via SES after successful email processing. Non-blocking (log errors, do not throw)
Extend: harden MIME parsing with graceful degradation for corrupted emails, partial data recovery
Extend: add CloudWatch alarm for DLQ messages, ensure DLQ wired to email receive Lambda event source mapping
Integration test: simulate inbound email, verify SES SendEmail called for backup forward with correct subject prefix and dashboard link
Integration test: verify behavior on corrupted MIME input, missing From header, oversized body, S3 read failure

parallelGroups.reason: Foundation: infrastructure, types, schemas, send path. Must complete first as all other slices depend on the email table schema, Lambda skeleton, and S3 bucket.

Independent read and write paths that can be built in parallel after slice 1. Slice 2 adds the thread view (read emails from DynamoDB). Slice 3 adds inbound processing (write emails from S3 events). No code overlap between them.
Depends on both slices 2 and 3. Mark-read requires the thread view (slice 2) to trigger auto-mark-read on open. Unread indicators require inbound emails (slice 3) to increment unreadEmailCount.
Final hardening after core features are complete. Backup forwarding depends on inbound processing (slice 3). Error handling tests exercise all paths built in earlier slices.
